exposure: mode of delivery (cesarean sections after labor)
outcome: Prevalence of disrespect and abuse during childbirth
cohort: 698 postpartum women in 21 maternity hospitals in 14 municipalities in Piauí, Brazil
finding: The study found a high prevalence of disrespect and abuse during childbirth, associated with structural conditions of the services, care practices, and characteristics of women.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections after labor were associated with disrespect and abuse during childbirth (aPR, 2.19; 95% CI, 1.64-3.59).
